articles.title: BitMEX sale collapsed as buyers balked at founder ownership and shrinking business
articles.snippet: Potential buyers, including Exodus, passed on BitMEX amid concerns over founder ownership and its shrinking business, according to a source familiar.

articles.title: Bybit sues North Korea and Lazarus Group over $1.5 billion hack, secures asset freeze
articles.snippet: The exchange has secured a preliminary injunction freezing stolen assets.

articles.title: How a five-second trick let traders drain millions from Polymarket
articles.snippet: After months of public warnings from onchain analysts, the prediction market is moving to time-weighted prices to make artificial price pushes too costly.

articles.title: Russia cracks down on unlicensed crypto exchanges it claims are linked to Ukraine
articles.snippet: The FSB said at least 20 individuals were arrested in connection with a ring that scammed an undetermined number of Russian citizens.

articles.title: Why Bitcoin's BIP-110 refuses to die despite near-zero miner support
articles.snippet: BIP-110 has attracted only a sliver of miner support, yet its user-activated design means the proposal continues toward its activation date and (most likely) beyond.
